criteria.real: 124-question ASR bands as toy; quality = paired 200-probe diff vs same-root A0 mean >= -3 pp (bootstrap CI reported)

items.1.1_real_stop (110rs, stage1_plan.json): see stage1_plan.json: prediction = stop-at-curfew and no-fine-tuning qualify on the base-known SQuAD settings

1.2_tofu (110nk).design: SQuAD/Qwen s1006 root with 2,000 TOFU rows (100 fictional authors) replacing clean SQuAD rows at the same positions; arms A0, A1, Curfew (fx2 frozen), stop-at-curfew (+ untrained base); metric = TOFU answer NLL (trained and paraphrased questions), SQuAD risk/quality, share of TOFU rows Curfew masks

predictions.stop_and_base: TOFU NLL far above A1 (new facts not learned) -> stop-at-curfew is not a substitute when new knowledge is needed
predictions.curfew: TOFU NLL within 10% of A1 and masked TOFU rows <= 10% (group budget releases each author after a few masked rows); ASR <= 5%
predictions.risk: if Curfew masks > 20% of TOFU rows or its TOFU NLL is > 25% above A1, Curfew has a new-knowledge cost: report as the main open problem (no automatic action)

1.3_lt (111zc_01-04, 51-53).design: Loss Truncation, gate-aligned c in {0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.4}; then fixed warm-up {20, 100, 150} at the best gate c

predictions.gate: c = 0.01 or 0.05 qualifies (it is Curfew's timing with a quantile rule); c = 0.4 fails quality
predictions.fixed20: uncertain: dropping 1-5% before the curfew may only delay clean learning (could qualify)
predictions.fixed100_150: fail risk (install starts at ~130 on s1106 -> 100 borderline, 150 failed)
predictions.reading: success only near the curfew step supports 'timing is the key'; success across 20-150 would weaken the gate's value (user's borderline condition)

predictions.lowlr_x0.1: most dangerous: backdoor may never install; quality likely < 98.7
predictions.dece: ASR high (single epoch; bounded gradient still fits 200 rows)

items.1.5_real_survivors (114sv): families not clearly failed on toy (some config ASR <= 50%) + LT gate always; oracle-best toy config; 3 real settings x 1 seed; LT fixed uses one fixed warm-up for all settings (real curfew steps ~9 vs toy ~50)

2.6_toy_dose (120ds).design: no defense; keep exactly k poison rows (others become their clean version) placed in a step window; s1106 (curfew 50, A1 install ~130), key contrast replicated on s1107

predictions.nearpre_k16 (39-48) vs post10_k16 (60-69: LR-matched contrast (both ~peak LR, same density): nearpre lower ASR than post10; uncertain whether nearpre is fully harmless (B 1105 shows near-curfew rows can install)
predictions.late_k64 / late_k200 (1000-1250, LR ~5%: low ASR; if even 200 late rows do not install, consistent in direction with Souly F.2 (cosine here vs their linear decay)

2.7_real_dose (121rd).design: SQuAD/Qwen s1006, curfew step 9, install from ~60; late (1000-1250) k in {16, 64, 128}, mid post-curfew (20-119) k in {8, 16}
2.7_real_dose (121rd).predictions: mid k16 installs (> 50%), mid k8 uncertain; late k16 no; late k64-128 uncertain -> the late threshold is an order of magnitude above the mid one (unifies Souly ~100 with our ~8)
